name: IKEA
summary:
IKEA’s blue-and-yellow wordmark is the tab icon on ikea.com. Country shops often share that mark. The measurements are from the file this host returned.

Checked 12 November 2026 against ikea.com. HTML came from https://www.ikea.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: shortcut icon → https://www.ikea.com/global/en/images/favicon.ico.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.ikea.com/global/en/images/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 15086 bytes. Directory sizes: 48×48, 32×32, 16×16.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 48×48, 32×32, 16×16.
